name: What It Feels Like
source:
Mylo Russo, an underachiever with a dream of making a name for himself through his songs, has spent the last years of his life chasing a guy who doesn't reciprocate those feelings the same way. Keeping it a secret from his family and friends, he finds himself in a  destructive loop, hoping the sun goes down quicker each day just to see him again...

That is, until he meets a strange, overtly friendly guy who turns his whole life on it's head in an instant. Together, they'll figure out what it means to love someone, yourself, and even a complete stranger - even if that love isn't real - and learn once and for all what it [i]really[/i] feels like.

[From [url=https://konpeitocat.itch.io/what-it-feels-like]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
麦洛·鲁索 (Mylo Russo) 是一名成绩不佳的学生，梦想通过歌曲成名，他在生命的最后几年里一直在追逐一个不能以同样方式回报这些感情的人。为了向家人和朋友保密，他发现自己陷入了一个毁灭性的循环，希望太阳每天落得更快，只是为了再次见到他……

也就是说，直到他遇到了一个奇怪的、公开友好的人，他的一生瞬间发生了翻天覆地的变化。他们将一起弄清楚爱某人、爱自己、甚至爱一个完全陌生的人意味着什么——即使这种爱并不真实——并一劳永逸地了解爱的含义。[i]真的[/i]感觉就像。

[来自[url=https://konpeitocat.itch.io/what-it-feels-like]痒痒io[/url]]
